rules: A critical FAIL is comparable evidence but is not promotion-qualified unless an exception was versioned here before formal execution.
A PARTIAL verdict is promotion-qualified only when the mutant is allowed by fault-suite.v1.json and an enforced policy was versioned here before formal execution.
Runtime caller-supplied exception maps are non-authoritative and cannot waive a recorded FAIL or PARTIAL verdict.
Any later policy change must create a new version and be recorded as a protocol deviation; it must not rewrite this frozen policy after outcomes are observed.
